messages:
katie: quick ping — PR #2741 is ready for merge, requesting runtime / infra / security reviews. Summary in PR: optimized batching kernel change, kv-cache TTL tweak, and a new canary deploy flag. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/2741. Need runtime for perf + correctness, infra for CI/canary and autoscale gating, security for a quick threat-model check. Target merge tonight 22:00 PT. @sam @lee @natalie :wave:
jordan: taking a look now. can you add perf numbers and a short rollback runbook to the PR description? makes approvals faster.
katie: done — added a perf table (p50/p95 throughput + token/sec), pasted the kernel perf log snippet, and a 2-step rollback plan under the 'ops' section. thanks.
sam: skimming — two small items: 1) kv cache TTL default should stay 1h unless there's strong reason to lower it (we saw evictions yesterday), 2) fallback path still logs at ERROR; please drop to WARN. i'll re-check after those changes; likely +1.
lee: infra note — CI needs the canary tag in the deploy job (so we can target canary instances), and the autoscale policy change should be behind a feature flag for rollout. i can push a tiny CI change in a follow-up commit and re-review.
natalie: quick security pass tomorrow morning at 9:00 PT. from a quick glance nothing blocking but pls add a short paragraph to the PR about threat model for the new config (privileged ops vs user-controlled inputs). that'll make signoff faster.
katie: thanks all — pushed fixes: TTL reverted to 1h with rationale comment, log level changed to WARN, added a short threat-model note, and included the canary tag in CI. @sam @lee please re-check when you can. aiming to merge in tonight's 22:00 PT window. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: Scheduled merge window reserved 2024-05-15 22:00 PT for PR #2741 (requested by katie).
